title_zh: 医院门诊 & 承包商安全管理（一）
title_en: Day1: Hospital Outpatient & Contractor Safety Management (I)

vocab.example_en: Hard hats are a mandatory requirement on all construction sites.
vocab.example_zh: 安全帽是所有施工现场的强制要求。

vocab.example_en: Please submit documents for pre-qualification two weeks before bid day.
vocab.example_zh: 请在投标日前两周提交资格预审文件。

vocab.example_en: Hazard identification is the first step of every risk assessment.
vocab.example_zh: 危险源辨识是每项风险评估的第一步。

vocab.example_en: Risk assessment determines what controls are needed for the task.
vocab.example_zh: 风险评估确定作业所需的管控措施。

vocab.example_en: Submit your work safety plan to the E. H. S. team for approval.
vocab.example_zh: 将作业安全方案提交给 E. H. S. 团队审批。

vocab.example_en: Both parties must sign off an agreement before mobilization.
vocab.example_zh: 双方必须在进场前签署协议。

vocab.en: prior to the commence of work
vocab.example_en: All training must be completed prior to the commence of work.
vocab.example_zh: 所有培训必须在开工之前完成。

vocab.example_en: Permits help control hazardous activities on the site.
vocab.example_zh: 许可证有助于管控现场的危险作业。

vocab.example_en: All contractors must comply with regulations of the host country.
vocab.example_zh: 所有承包商必须遵守东道国的法规。

vocab.example_en: The safety officer will verify training records before site access.
vocab.example_zh: 入场前安全员会核验培训记录。

vocab.example_en: All crew members must familiarize themselves with local standards.
vocab.example_zh: 所有班组成员必须熟悉本地标准。

vocab.example_en: We integrate safety management into project planning from day one.
vocab.example_zh: 我们从项目规划第一天起就把安全管理融入其中。

vocab.example_en: Each new hire must complete the designated online training modules.
vocab.example_zh: 每位新员工必须完成指定的线上培训模块。

vocab.example_en: Comply with central, provincial and local regulations at all times.
vocab.example_zh: 始终遵守国家、省、地方法规。

vocab.example_en: Electrical safety standards must be followed for live work.
vocab.example_zh: 带电作业必须遵守电气安全标准。

vocab.example_en: The inspector will cite any contractor who violates the E. H. S. rules.
vocab.example_zh: 检查员会对违反 E. H. S. 规定的承包商开具处罚。

vocab.example_en: Three citations in a quarter will trigger a performance review.
vocab.example_zh: 一个季度内三次违规处罚将触发绩效评审。

vocab.example_en: Designate one safety representative for each work crew.
vocab.example_zh: 为每个作业班组指派一名安全代表。

vocab.example_en: Distribute the E. H. S. manual to all crew members before entry.
vocab.example_zh: 入场前将 E. H. S. 手册发放给所有班组成员。

vocab.example_en: The E. H. S. team will conduct inspections on a weekly basis.
vocab.example_zh: E. H. S. 团队将每周开展检查。

vocab.example_en: Verify that all licenses are valid before mobilization.
vocab.example_zh: 进场前核验所有许可证的有效性。

vocab.example_en: Workers must identify hazards before starting any new task.
vocab.example_zh: 工人必须在开始任何新作业前识别危险源。

vocab.example_en: Evaluate risks before selecting controls for the task.
vocab.example_zh: 选择管控措施前先评估风险。
